items.title: Hackers Exploiting Windows Server Update Services Flaw to Steal Sensitive Data from Organizations
items.description: Windows Server Update Services (WSUS) vulnerability actively exploited in the wild. Criminals are using this vulnerability to steal sensitive data from organizations in various industries. The vulnerability, tracked as CVE-2025-59287, was patched by Microsoft on October 14, 2025, but attackers quickly began abusing it after proof-of-concept code became publicly available on GitHub.
